area: Community Park, civic center and surrounding neighborhoods, Broomfield, Colorado
coordinates: Meter coordinates east and south of the origin. The north-up image covers the same extent. Projected offsets use a cosine correction at the origin latitude.

sources.name: City and County of Broomfield GIS
sources.use: Building footprints, streets, trail centerlines, tree positions and species, forestry height classes in feet, and place names. The local Web Mercator scale correction preserves ground meters. Unmeasured buildings use building-type estimates. Missing trail and street widths are estimated.
sources.terms: Broomfield provides selected GIS datasets free of charge. Broomfield places responsibility for their use on the user; see the GIS data page for the published disclaimer.

Addresses.use: The public address point locates the Dover collectible. The doorway, Hall of Gravy and collectible are original game scenery.

ParkAmenities.use: Named local features on the neighborhood maps, including Blue Pod at County Commons. Portable soccer equipment is representative.

sources.name: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery
sources.use: North-up aerial photograph and hand-traced shorelines of Community Park Pond and Brunner Reservoir.
sources.terms: Public-domain U.S. government orthoimagery in the conterminous United States.

courseImages.files: brunner, commons, flatiron, northmoor and derda JPEGs in courses/

sources.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program
sources.use: The regional 129 × 129 grid samples USGS bare-earth terrain every 150 meters. A 10-meter grid covers Community Park, Brunner Farmhouse, Dover Street, and County Commons. Both datasets use real vertical meters relative to the same regional origin, with a 120-meter transition band at the edge of the detailed grid.
sources.terms: U.S. Geological Survey public-domain elevation data.
sources.detailSampling: USGS 1/3 arc-second bare-earth DEM, bilinear reprojection to a 10-meter local ground grid, elevations rounded to decimeters. Rebuild with scripts/geo_terrain.py.

sources.name: USGS 3DEP Colorado DRCOG 2 lidar, 2020
sources.terms: U.S. Geological Survey public-domain elevation data.
sources.use: Estimated individual roof and crown heights for the Community Park, Brunner, County Commons, and Dover play areas. City footprints retain their mapped horizontal coordinates. Roof estimates use the 85th percentile of returns inside the footprint, relative to nearby ground returns. Crown estimates use the 95th percentile near the mapped trunk, restricted to the closest tree, within its reported size band where available. Trees planted after the survey retain city class estimates where dates are available. Heights and crown shapes remain approximate. Rebuild the derived height fields with scripts/geo_scale.py after refreshing city features.

sources.name: State of Colorado Imagery, Denver Regional Aerial Photography Project (DRAPP), 2020
sources.use: Public orthophotography registered to the Dover course, including rooftops and the asphalt sample. The block’s turning circle, sidewalk edges, driveway aprons and approximate crown centers were traced from the aerial. Fifteen residential roof surfaces and the approximate crown heights use the 2020 USGS laser survey. The two houses at the game cottage have custom models. Their front elevations and yard scenery approximate the supplied July 2026 street view.
